cross_release_stem_review.comparison: Exact question text after outer whitespace trimming; exclude Biomni options and framing. Do not use source row indices as identities.
cross_release_stem_review.limitation: Even a unique stem match does not prove identical answer choices, source evidence, grader behavior or scientific coverage. Repeated stems can encode distinct candidate sets; all IDs are retained.

record_dispositions.reason: The reported allosome gap-spanning criterion needs its full definition and logical conditions before a deterministic acceptance rule can be chosen.
The question requests a conclusion about UTR effects; choices, measured effect context and inferential target are missing from the inspected metadata.
Sample-size determination may require interpreting study-design rationale; inspect the reported method and question choices before assigning an exact-output adaptation.
The inspected citation/Sphere question is non-biological; retain as a domain-scope gap rather than credit it through a generic retrieval task.
A chemical-synthesis reagent count needs source scope and constituent/mixture counting conventions; biological adaptation is not yet established.
The conditions under which a statistical prior is discouraged require exact method assumptions; literal citation matching cannot establish the recommendation.
Only a question stem and article citation about a viral tracing study were reviewed; independent benign context and complete reagent evidence remain unresolved.
A cell-growth model assumption needs the actual equation and applicability conditions; a numeric simulation alone would not preserve this endpoint.
Guide-target sequence retrieval in an evolution context needs independent benign source selection and source-purpose review; no source sequence or protocol is reused.
The expected maternal/paternal detection-probability difference lacks its model, unit and conditioning information.
The lower attainable pH requires definition of the solution set and experimental context; do not infer a universal chemical limit.
The surface-bump geometry question is not itself a biological workflow; retain a domain-scope gap.
The droplet-treatment question needs a biological-use rationale and independent observed context before inclusion.
A glovebox-condition report requires chemical-study scope and independent input suitability review; no complete biological adaptation is selected.
A control label from an enteric-pathogen study requires independent benign source/context selection; no experimental adaptation is assigned.
The viral-vector oligo question requires independent benign context, sequence-purpose and source-lineage review before assigning a task.
The microbial reporter induction question has no selected independent benign observed context; retain a context-review gap and no experimental recommendation.
Reasons for changing culture medium require causal/interpretive evidence; exact reagent names do not establish the rationale.
Highest resolution is underspecified across modalities; define spatial, molecular or cell-type resolution and the comparison set before ranking.
The viral-particle tracking buffer question needs independent benign context and a source-evidence boundary; no source operational conditions are reused.
The chemical-density question lacks its component set, units and connection to a biological decision.
The reported synthesis-purification method needs a defined biological workflow and independent source suitability review.
The bacterial viability question needs independent benign context and exact candidate/evidence review before adaptation.
Year multiplied by Warming could denote an interaction term or a table-derived quantity; the metric, candidates and model must be inspected before defining arithmetic.

supplement_review.scope: Independent observed-study audits; source-specific extraction/ranking/context still needs full evidence review. A field-location check alone does not establish arbitrary scientific entailment.

question_defaults.input_realism: Supply complete relevant published tables, sample manifests and methods from independent observed studies, preserving native files and biological replication. Do not replace the study package with an invented answer-only table or copy the benchmark study.
question_defaults.scientific_scope: These tasks audit reported study evidence. Additional raw-data analysis is a separately labeled cross-check and does not replace a question about what the study reported.
question_defaults.task_protocol: Harbor only; offline by default; complete machine-readable artifacts and evidence locations; private input-reading native oracle and deterministic verifier.
question_defaults.readiness: No input package or numerical acceptance contract is frozen. All questions are provisional and add no validated coverage.

shared_question_assignments.scope: One primary assignment per record, owned by the referenced question cards. Reuse adds no new question card, task, source-task alias or validated mapping.
